parsed.name: 光束剖面强度监视器
parsed.description: 用于束线诊断的光束剖面强度监视器。该设备通过Y向插入/移出机构将YAG靶或二极管送入光路，并结合变焦机构和面阵探测器来观察光束形貌与强度分布；部分变体还带有调焦或LED照明功能。
parsed.description_en: A beam diagnostics profile intensity monitor. It inserts or retracts a YAG target or diode into the beam path via a Y-axis mechanism, and uses zoom optics with an area detector to observe beam profile and intensity distribution; some variants also include focus control or LED illumination.
